name: Planet Douitsutai
source:
I lost my memory and woke up in the Magic Institute.

In front of me was my lover, the witch Prata. His love was heavy and distorted... I wanted to escape.

What is the end of love that awaits me before I regain my lost dreams and memories?

[From [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/28253]Freem![/url]]
translation:
我失去了记忆，在魔法研究所醒来。

眼前的人是我的恋人，巫师普拉塔。他的爱沉重而扭曲…我想逃走。

在找回遗失的梦与记忆之前，等待我的，究竟是爱情的何种终局？

[摘自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/28253]Freem![/url]]
